headline: Narayana Hrudayalaya Jumps 6.9% After Q2 EPS Beat
summary: Narayana Hrudayalaya shares jumped 6.9% after the healthcare provider beat earnings per share expectations for the second quarter of 2026.
why: Strong earnings reports from healthcare operators signal robust patient volumes and cost management capabilities, influencing sectoral valuations.

impacts.why: Beating consensus EPS expectations directly spurred investor buying and stock price appreciation.
